summary: The community is discussing adding a new logical type, VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR), to represent fixed‑length numeric vectors in Parquet while enforcing non‑null and finite constraints. Concurrently, a proposal introduces a two‑tiered versioning scheme—add‑everywhere and compatibility level—to speed feature rollout while ensuring readers interpret data correctly.

highlights.text: Proposal to add a logical type VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR) for fixed‑length numeric vectors with non‑null and finite constraints.
